gaps.sentence: The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.
The bridge has a maximum ___ (WEIGH) of ten tonnes.

gaps.explanation: 'Highly suspicious' — the adjective for something that looks wrong.

gaps.sentence: The bacteria are ___ (SEE) to the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: 'Invisible' = impossible to see — the negative adjective from VISIBLE/SEE.

gaps.sentence: It is ___ (DENY) that the policy has failed.
gaps.explanation: 'It is undeniable that …' — adjective meaning cannot be denied.
People are satisfied; things are satisfying or satisfactory.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.
